description: This file contains unit tests for various context-related utility functions and a registry used in an AI or language model project. The tests cover functions that manipulate context windows, resolve context tokens, and manage runtime registry objects, specifically targeting features like context window configuration, provider-specific settings, and model parameter resolution.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredContextWindows
methods.description: Applies context window settings based on discovered models and their provider-specific IDs, updating a cache with minimum context window sizes per model ID.

methods.name: applyConfiguredContextWindows
methods.description: Overrides cache entries for models based on user-defined configuration, without overwriting provider-qualified discovery entries and handling invalid entries gracefully.

methods.name: createSessionManagerRuntimeRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry object that manages key-value pairs indexed by object identity, allowing storage, retrieval, and removal of associated runtime data.

methods.name: resolveContextTokensForModel
methods.description: Determines the number of context tokens for a given model based on configuration parameters, model-specific flags, and fallback values, prioritizing per-model settings and special flags like context1m.
